steps.text: Start Anubis and open the local address. Retrieve your private token from [[value:.anubis/identities.json]]. Paste it into [[field:Access token]] and click [[control:Open workspace]]. Never share the token.

Click [[control:Consultant Copilot]]. Set [[field:Customer workload name]] = [[value:Orchid Neocloud assisted playbook]]. Set [[field:Data classification]] = [[value:Public — permitted for direct provider processing]]. Click [[control:Start assisted engagement]].

Select your tested connection in [[field:Model connection]]. Enter the following paragraph in [[field:What should we know about the workload?]]: [[value:Fictional customer Orchid Neocloud. This is a planning exercise. Activities can overlap. Multiple tenants share the factory. Use the exact activity name "Premium model endpoints". It serves text with a language model. No retrieval or tool orchestration. Compute is inside this AI Factory. Reserve dedicated capacity for this activity. Explicit planning assumptions: dense8b, 60 peak requests per minute, 1 model call per request, 2000 input tokens and 500 output tokens per call. ]].

Append the following paragraph to [[field:What should we know about the workload?]]: [[value:Use the exact activity name "Standard model endpoints". It serves text with a language model. No retrieval or tool orchestration. Compute is inside this AI Factory. Shared capacity within its activity pool. Explicit planning assumptions: dense8b, 300 peak requests per minute, 1 model call per request, 2000 input tokens and 500 output tokens per call. ]].

Append the following paragraph to [[field:What should we know about the workload?]]: [[value:Do not add other activities or infer local storage from an outside corpus. Unknown storage and network measurements remain unknown.]]. Click [[control:Ask copilot]].
Wait while Copilot interprets the description. The active status indicator confirms that it is still working. Do not submit duplicate requests.

Review the proposed activities, placement, measurements and assumptions against the input register. Check [[field:I reviewed the selected values and accept the planning assumptions.]]. Click [[control:Apply selected]]. Specialist reference inputs are entered during the next review.
Click [[control:Review and calculate GPU estimate]]. The readiness panel names any missing inputs. Complete them in the guided review. Copilot has not invented reference throughput.
Set [[field:Factory users]] = [[value:Multiple tenants]]. Set [[field:Do activities run at the same time?]] = [[value:Yes — overlapping demand]].
Set [[field:Component name 1]] = [[value:Premium model endpoints]]. Set [[field:Compute location 1]] = [[value:In this factory]]. Set [[field:Reserve dedicated capacity 1]] [[state:checked]].

Set [[field:Component name 2]] = [[value:Standard model endpoints]]. Set [[field:Compute location 2]] = [[value:In this factory]]. Set [[field:Reserve dedicated capacity 2]] [[state:unchecked]]. Set [[field:Relationship 2]] = [[value:Independent]].
Set [[field:Model preset]] = [[value:dense8b]]. Set [[field:Describe demand using]] = [[value:Requests per minute]].
Set [[field:Peak requests per minute]] = [[value:60]]. Set [[field:Model calls per request or job]] = [[value:1]].
Set [[field:Input tokens per model call]] = [[value:2000]]. Set [[field:Output tokens per model call]] = [[value:500]].
Set [[field:Model preset]] = [[value:dense8b]]. Set [[field:Describe demand using]] = [[value:Requests per minute]].
Set [[field:Peak requests per minute]] = [[value:300]]. Set [[field:Model calls per request or job]] = [[value:1]].
Set [[field:Input tokens per model call]] = [[value:2000]]. Set [[field:Output tokens per model call]] = [[value:500]].

Confirm [[control:GPU estimate inputs are ready]]. Retain the displayed B300 enterprise deployment profile and [[field:Sensitivity envelope]] = [[value:±30%]]. Check [[field:Use these planning assumptions]]. Click [[control:Calculate estimate]].

Read the GPU workload comparison. Expected B300 = [[value:16]], B200 = [[value:16]], H200 = [[value:16]] GPUs. These workload counts are separate from the [[value:256]] GPU factory deployment anchor. Click [[control:Export result]] to save the calculation.

Click [[control:Continue to Design handoff]], then [[control:Prepare projection]]. Read the executive summary and download the design intake and companion specification. Unresolved network and storage measurements remain explicit.

Click [[control:Explain this to me]]. Set [[field:Explanation connection]] = [[value:DeepSeek consultant walkthrough]]. Check [[field:This saved result is public or fictional and may be sent to the selected provider]] for this fictional exercise. Click [[control:Generate explanation]]. The saved calculation cannot be changed by this action.

Read the explanation of the workload GPUs, deployment anchor, memory, storage and all network roles. Expand [[control:Source fields and assumptions]] to trace the explanation. Click [[control:Download explanation]], then [[control:Close]].

Scroll down within [[control:Explain this to me]] to read [[control:Factory networks]] and [[control:What to do next]]. Expand [[control:Source fields and assumptions]] if needed. Click [[control:Download explanation]] to save the text. Scroll to the top and click [[control:Close]] to continue.

Set [[field:Completion notes]] = [[value:Planning requirements and explanation delivered. Outstanding network and storage measurements remain in the companion specification.]]. Check [[field:I confirm that these selected requirements are delivered.]]. Click [[control:Complete engagement]].
The engagement is complete. Its exact calculation, handoff and explanation remain saved. Use [[control:Cases]] to reopen the engagement and [[control:Saved deliverables]] to retrieve its documents.

story:
Fictional customer Orchid Neocloud. This is a planning exercise. Activities can overlap. Multiple tenants share the factory. Use the exact activity name "Premium model endpoints". It serves text with a language model. No retrieval or tool orchestration. Compute is inside this AI Factory. Reserve dedicated capacity for this activity. Explicit planning assumptions: dense8b, 60 peak requests per minute, 1 model call per request, 2000 input tokens and 500 output tokens per call. 
Use the exact activity name "Standard model endpoints". It serves text with a language model. No retrieval or tool orchestration. Compute is inside this AI Factory. Shared capacity within its activity pool. Explicit planning assumptions: dense8b, 300 peak requests per minute, 1 model call per request, 2000 input tokens and 500 output tokens per call. 
Do not add other activities or infer local storage from an outside corpus. Unknown storage and network measurements remain unknown.
